info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Carrental Reservations Returns-v2-spec
info.description: The Car Rental Reservations Return API provides a seamless method for retrieving a list of returned car rental reservations. This operation allows businesses to manage and track vehicle returns efficiently. Users can access essential information regarding each return, including reservation details and timings. This API is designed for car rental service providers and fleet managers who need to analyze return trends and optimize fleet management operations. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can enhance their customer service and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about the return process for reservations, including relevant dates, conditions, and terms for returning items.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving reserved items. This should include the relevant identification details to process the return.

200.description: The request was successful, and the return reservation details are provided.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to reservations. It is expected to be in JSON string format.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reservation reference.

resultId.description: The ID of the result for the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's result.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsResponse.description: Response schema for the operations GET request related to reservations.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the reservation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
